instruction.text: Find and select the 6 toys in the playroom.
Which time period do you think this playroom is from?

feedback.finish: Nowadays, playrooms have lots of different kinds of toys, such as electric keyboards, remote-control cars and games consoles. Let’s find out what was popular in playrooms in the past ...

instruction.text: Match these older toys to their names.

feedback.end: Chess is a two player game played with a wooden board and 32 pieces.
A rocking horse is a toy wooden horse that a child can sit on and rock back and forth.
Marbles are small glass balls that can be used in different games or rolled along in races.

end.text: Yo-yos can move up and down the string they are attached to. You can even perform fun tricks with them!
end.sound: ssml:<phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='ˈjəʊ.jəʊs'>Yo-yos</phoneme> can move up and down the string they are attached to. You can even perform fun tricks with them!

instruction.text: Which materials do you think these toys are made of?

feedback.finish: Before the invention of plastic, most toys were made out of wood, metal and glass. It was only after the Second World War that plastic toys became popular in British households.

instruction.text: Select the toy vehicle that can only be found in a modern playroom.
What is the main difference between these two toys?

b.sound: the red car is powered by a remote which needs electricity.

feedback.finish: As well as being transformed by plastic, lots of toys have become electronic. For example, toy cars that previously used springs to move forward are now often controlled by a battery-powered remote.
